ranking: largest positive weighted attention-share gap; DSA minus equal-weight Democratic/Republican average
attention_ratio_basis: DSA subject share / ((Democratic subject share + Republican subject share) / 2); null when the baseline share is zero
presentation: original density map with September 2026 national DSA policy paraphrases and full-period attention-share comparisons
weighting: equal bundle mass within each organization, equal eligible claim mass within each bundle

topics.title: Institutional Power, Oppression, and Social Conflict
topics.anchor_scope: central historical issue example, not the current policy passage
topics.snippet: DSA calls for ending ICE detention and deportations, amnesty for immigrants regardless of status, and a path to citizenship for permanent residents.
topics.snippet_basis: assistant paraphrase of the source-bound September 2026 national program passage; historical map anchors and topic assignments unchanged
topics.source_claim_text: End U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention and deportations.
topics.source_evidence: [PDF page 15] END THE U.S. WAR MACHINE Defund the Department of War. End all foreign wars and close overseas military bases. Support and fully employ veterans. End immunity for U.S. war criminals and support the International Criminal Court’s mandate to prosecute war crimes. FREE PALESTINE Recognize the rights of the Palestinian people, including the right of return, the right to resist military occupation, and the right to self determination in a free Palestine with Jerusalem as its capital. End all military and economic aid to Israel. Prosecute U.S. and Israeli leaders responsible for the genocide in Gaza. END BLOCKADES, EMBARGOES, AND SANCTIONS People around the world deserve to live their lives without U.S. interference. End economic warfare against countries whose governments act independently of the United States, such as Cuba, Venezuela, and Iran. ABOLISH ICE End ICE detention and deportations and punish federal agents’ brutality. Legalize migration, grant amnesty for all immigrants regardless of status, provide a path to citizenship for all permanent residents, and end visa caps and quotas. 15 Workers Deserve More!
